brand.headline: Source garments from verified factories, without the risk.
brand.subhead: GarmentGate manages every quote, sample, order and payment between you and the factory.

verified.title: Verified manufacturers
verified.body: Every factory is audited and certificate-checked before it can quote.

escrow.title: Protected payments
escrow.body: Your money is held in escrow and released as production milestones are met.

managed.title: One point of contact

company.title: Tell us about your company
